findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "list_levels" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: List Ready4Bots levels R0 through R4, plus seal variants R4-N and R4-W. R3: purchase-ready – the agent reaches checkout; only the final purchase step is not yet…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_business, check_website, can_agent_buy, read_board · Private data: search_businesses · Public sink: submit_report, post_to_board, reply_on_board · Destructive: check_website, can_agent_buy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_business, check_website, can_agent_buy, read_board · Private data: search_businesses · Public sink: submit_report, post_to_board, reply_on_board · Destructive: check_website, can_agent_buy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
